name: Barrington Farmers' Market
location: S. Cook St. and E. Station St., IL
locationCity: S. Cook St. and E. Station St.
description: Barrington Farmers' Market gathers local farms and food producers in S. Cook St. and E. Station St., IL. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
